name: @penguinharness/model-development
description: Model development on your own hardware: fine-tune with LlamaFactory, run local models with Ollama, and serve them with vLLM.

penguin.description_zh: 在自己的硬件上做模型开发：用 LlamaFactory 微调、用 Ollama 运行本地模型、用 vLLM 部署服务。
penguin.short_description: Fine-tune, run and serve models locally.
penguin.short_description_zh: 本地微调、运行与部署模型。

quick_start.prompt: Check whether Ollama is installed on this machine. If it is, list the local models and show a request to one of them through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Do not pull any model without asking me.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 检查这台机器上是否装了 Ollama。如果装了，列出本地模型，并演示通过 OpenAI 兼容端点向其中一个发请求。未经我同意不要拉取任何模型。
